title:
The cock crew,
 The sky was blue:
 The bells in heaven
 Were striking eleven.
 ’Tis time for this poor soul
 To go to heaven.
html_source:
The classroom is dotted throughout Joyce’s writings (Araby, An Encounter, The Dead, Portrait) where he can paint the relationship between authority and rebellion on one canvas.

Joyce taught and was known for unorthodox methods on one occasion was caught sliding down a balustrade with students in tow (John Rickard, Studies in the Literary Imagination, XXX,2,1997).
